description: Replace file: null with a filename relative to public/audio, e.g. npc-greeting.mp3. Null uses a built-in procedural placeholder. Volume is a per-file multiplier (0 to 2). Reload after changing files; rebuild for standalone distribution.

npc.greeting.use: Opening a deal or answering a phone call; friendly wordless greeting

npc.chatter.use: Counteroffers and nearby NPC conversations; short wordless chatter

npc.agreement.use: Accepted deal, parts purchase, courier hiring, staff training

npc.decline.use: Declining a deal; descending wordless response

phone.ring.use: Incoming phone call, repeats every six seconds until answered or snoozed

ui.denied.use: Action blocked by cost, distance or progression

purchase.build.use: Buying a build pad, parts station upgrade or personal car

cash.receive.use: New committed income, including automatic parts sales

repair.tool.use: Mechanical repair actions and nearby working mechanics

repair.pour.use: Oil pouring, rate limited while held

repair.complete.use: Completed repair job or car discovery

camera.shutter.use: Listing photos and repair photo targets

car.impact.light.use: Minor chassis collision above 1.4 m/s normal impact speed

car.impact.heavy.use: Hard chassis collision above 5 m/s normal impact speed

car.door.use: Entering or exiting a drivable car

car.start.use: Engine ignition when entering a drivable car

car.rev.use: Short vroom after a successful UI action sends a tycoon car on a route, sells it for departure, or places a selected personal car

garage.store.use: Poof and chime when keeping a repaired car in the personal collection
